text_block_list.text:
Brian's making some amazing progress at
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... huff...

She's running along the beach alone, using
her drive to race as fuel to
push forward.
But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Phew... That's the morning routine done.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The afternoon will be free practice as
planned... Hm?

Summer camp should be a special
opportunity for her to race against
others
too. I wonder who—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Get your head in the game.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

I decide to find a practice partner right
away so we can make the
most out of this
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Is that my trainer? What's going on
over there?

text_block_list.name: Bun-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A scrimmage against Narita Brian?!
Absolutely not! I can already
picture my
humiliating defeat!

text_block_list.name: Bun-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-well, sure, but still... Umm, geez... I
dunno...

text_block_list.name: Blue-ribboned Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'd need to build up my skills
first before racing Brian. It'd
be rude to
waste her time.

text_block_list.name: Blue-ribboned Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I hear what you're saying, and maybe I'm
just making excuses... But
sorry, I'll need
to think about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...What's the deal? Why are you trying so
hard?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Thinking back, that stubbornness was the
same when we first met. It
never mattered
how dismissive I was...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you... trying to share my hunger for
racing? This... painful burden
of mine?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I guess that's just who my trainer is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Thinking about it like that, maybe
we're both looking for some
extra fire to
keep us burning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(After all, it was you who gave me this
chance. You got my passion for
running to
thrive again.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My desire is still strong. It only gets
stronger the more I run. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It feels nostalgic too... Like something I
thought I'd lost...

In my frantic search for a practice
opponent, I don't even realize it's
gotten
dark out.

In the end, not one person would accept,
and I'm left empty-handed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's summer, but the breeze gets chilly at
night. You'll catch a cold out
here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I know what you've been up to all day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. Plenty of opponents
will be waiting back at the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I did find something, though. In all my craving for a challenge, I realized I had hope too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I think maybe you taught me that. So,
well...

She's not one to hesitate when she talks.
Could this mean she's...
trying to cheer me
up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You know...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Good. Let's get back.

While we walk back, Brian is almost acting
shy. And though it's faint,
she even smiles
a bit, like a little kid.

I step outside the next morning and see
something unbelievable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Blue-ribboned Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I thought about it, and I'd like to at least
give it a try. A chance like
this doesn't
come often after all.

text_block_list.name: Bun-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And it's important to get a real sense for
where you're at! So, like...

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: You're on, Narita Brian!

Lined up outside the dorms is a crowd of
all the runners I'd asked
yesterday to race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha! I guess drive is contagious. I can
see you're all burning with
it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But it's the same for me... All right. I'll take
each and every one of you
on!

text_block_list.name: Blue-ribboned Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Blue-ribboned Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You've found yourself a great trainer.
Honestly, I'm jealous.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... Damn straight.

Waves crash amid the thunderous
footsteps of the fired up racers.
The sound
of it leaves me in awe.
